stage_entry.text: 开始上腹部切口，先建立稳定的进入路径。
stage_entry.text_en: Begin the upper abdominal incision. Establish a stable entry route first.

stage_entry.text: 切开和止血需要的器械已经就位。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments for incision and haemostasis are ready.

stage_entry.text: 先完成腹腔探查，再确认接下来的暴露范围。
stage_entry.text_en: Complete the abdominal exploration before confirming how much exposure we need next.

stage_entry.text: 需要把上腹部的术野再充分暴露出来。
stage_entry.text_en: We need fuller exposure of the upper abdominal field.

stage_entry.text: 粘连范围比较广，先确认分离层次。
stage_entry.text_en: The adhesions are extensive. Let us identify the dissection plane first.

stage_entry.text: 这里的组织层次不清楚，分离要仔细。
stage_entry.text_en: The tissue planes are unclear here. Dissect carefully.

stage_entry.text: 先把术野暴露稳定，再继续分离。
stage_entry.text_en: Let us establish stable exposure before continuing the dissection.

precision_failed.text: ……这个分离层次需要重新调整。
precision_failed.text_en: ...We need to adjust this dissection plane.

precision_failed.text: 先停一下，这一处还需要修正。
precision_failed.text_en: Pause here. This area still needs correction.

stage_entry.text: 先确认主要血管的走行，再决定分离路径。
stage_entry.text_en: Identify the course of the major vessels before deciding the dissection route.

stage_entry.text: 这一步要把术前影像和实际术野对照清楚。
stage_entry.text_en: Compare the preoperative images carefully with the actual field at this step.

stage_entry.text: 门静脉就在附近，控制好牵拉。
stage_entry.text_en: The portal vein is nearby. Keep traction controlled.

stage_entry.text: 血管边界已经看到了，接下来要细一点。
stage_entry.text_en: The vessel boundary is visible now. We need to proceed more delicately.

precision_failed.text: 这里的处理不够稳妥，需要调整。
precision_failed.text_en: This was not handled securely enough. It needs adjustment.

precision_failed.text: 暂缓继续，这一步还没有处理到位。
precision_failed.text_en: Hold off on continuing. This step is not yet satisfactory.

stage_entry.text: 进入胰头深部了，注意邻近血管的牵拉。
stage_entry.text_en: We are entering the deep pancreatic head. Watch the traction on nearby vessels.

stage_entry.text: 钩突附近的空间有限，先稳住暴露。
stage_entry.text_en: Space around the uncinate process is limited. Stabilize exposure first.

stage_entry.text: 深部的分离层次要逐步确认，不能急。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm the deep dissection plane gradually. Do not rush.

precision_failed.text: 深部组织还没有分离到位，需要修正。
precision_failed.text_en: The deep tissue has not been fully separated. We need to correct it.

precision_failed.text: 这一处没有按计划分开，先停下调整。
precision_failed.text_en: This area did not separate as planned. Stop and adjust it first.

stage_entry.text: 准备取出标本，之后要重新整理术野。
stage_entry.text_en: Prepare to remove the specimen. Then we need to reorganize the field.

stage_entry.text: 切除阶段接近结束，接下来转入重建。
stage_entry.text_en: Resection is nearly complete. Reconstruction comes next.

stage_entry.text: 胰肠吻合需要的缝线已经准备好了。
stage_entry.text_en: The sutures for the pancreaticojejunostomy are ready.

stage_entry.text: 接下来是胰肠重建，先确认吻合位置。
stage_entry.text_en: Next is pancreaticoenteric reconstruction. Let us confirm the anastomosis site first.

precision_failed.text: 吻合还没有达到要求，需要重新处理。
precision_failed.text_en: The anastomosis is not yet satisfactory. It needs to be redone.

precision_failed.text: 先不要继续下一步，这里必须修正。
precision_failed.text_en: Do not move on yet. This must be corrected first.

stage_entry.text: 胆肠吻合需要的缝线已经备齐。
stage_entry.text_en: The sutures for the biliary-enteric anastomosis are ready.

stage_entry.text: 现在重建胆道通路，先确认吻合位置。
stage_entry.text_en: We are reconstructing the biliary pathway now. Confirm the anastomosis site first.

stage_entry.text: 把胆管断端和肠袢的关系保持清楚。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep the relationship between the bile duct stump and the bowel loop clear.

precision_failed.text: 胆肠吻合尚需调整，先别推进下一步。
precision_failed.text_en: The biliary-enteric anastomosis needs adjustment. Do not move on yet.

precision_failed.text: 这里的吻合还不理想，需要修正。
precision_failed.text_en: This anastomosis is not satisfactory yet. It needs correction.

stage_entry.text: 接下来进行胃肠通路的重建。
stage_entry.text_en: Next, we will reconstruct the gastrointestinal pathway.

stage_entry.text: 确认胃和空肠的位置，再继续吻合。
stage_entry.text_en: Confirm the positions of the stomach and jejunum before continuing the anastomosis.

stage_entry.text: 保持重建区稳定，注意不要过度牵拉。
stage_entry.text_en: Keep the reconstruction area stable. Avoid excessive traction.

precision_failed.text: 胃肠吻合的状态不理想，需要调整。
precision_failed.text_en: The gastrointestinal anastomosis is not satisfactory. We need to adjust it.

precision_failed.text: 这一处尚未完成到预定标准，先修正。
precision_failed.text_en: This area has not reached the intended standard yet. Correct it first.

stage_entry.text: 准备逐一复核重建区域，再做最终止血。
stage_entry.text_en: Prepare to review each reconstruction area before final haemostasis.

stage_entry.text: 几处吻合都要检查，尤其注意交界部位。
stage_entry.text_en: Check every anastomosis, paying particular attention to the junctions.

stage_entry.text: 现在核对器械和纱布的最终清点记录。
stage_entry.text_en: Now check the final instrument and swab count records.

stage_entry.text: 我再核对一次清点结果和手术记录。
stage_entry.text_en: I will check the counts and operative record once more.

stage_entry.text: 准备关闭切口，确认可以结束手术。
stage_entry.text_en: Prepare to close the incision. Confirm that we can finish the operation.

stage_entry.text: 关闭需要的器械和缝线已经就位。
stage_entry.text_en: The instruments and sutures for closure are ready.
